{{Top|leg}}
'''Point-of-impact shielding''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] equipped their [[SD-10 battle droid]]s with point-of-impact shielding. The shielding was created by a [[Point-of-impact Shield Generator]] located within the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] chest.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
